title: California Exterior Upgrade Ideas | Modern Stone Transformation
description: See how this California home transformed its exterior with a modern stone upgrade no major renovation required. Real before & after.
text:
Make Your California Home Look Custom Built Without a Full Remodel
See how a simple exterior upgrade transformed this home’s curb appeal with a modern stone look no demolition or major construction required.

Courtney Mintz

Project Coordinator

Hi, I’m Courtney, and I worked with this homeowner in California on a simple but high-impact exterior upgrade.

The home itself had great structure and layout, but like many properties, it had that “builder-grade” look. The lower half of the exterior felt flat and unfinished, which made the entire front of the house look more basic than it really was.

They weren’t looking for a major renovation, just something that would elevate the look and make the home feel more modern and intentional.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

Exterior Transformation with Stone Siding
From Outdated Brick to Modern Stone • Without Removing the Old Brick

A simple material upgrade completely changed the feel of this home, from basic brick to a clean, modern stone finish that elevates the entire exterior. Instead of replacing the entire exterior, we focused on the area that makes the biggest visual impact the lower façade.

✅ Installed directly over existing brick

✅ No demolition required

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

A Complete Exterior Transformation Without a Full Remodel
A simple upgrade turned this builder-grade exterior into a clean, custom look adding depth, contrast, and a high-end finish without major construction.

Before

The Goal

- Exterior felt flat and outdated

- Needed more visual interest

- Wanted a more modern, high-end appearance

- No interest in a full remodel or major construction

After

The Solution

- Add depth and texture

- Create contrast with the upper siding

- Modernize the overall look

- Avoid the cost and complexity of masonry

What Does a Project Like this Cost?

Most homeowners are surprised how affordable upgrades like this can be. Projects like this typically range between $1,800–$2,300

Try Visualizer Get Project Planning Guide

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels, Corners, Ledgers

- Color: Arctic Smoke

- Install: Over Existing Brick

Will This Work Over Brick Like This Project?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface. To install over brick, simply use Tapcon screws.

Why Not Just Replace the Brick?

That would add thousands in additional costs and GenStone is lightweight, so there’s no reason to remove the brick substrate.

Arctic Smoke Color Guide

This combination was chosen to create a modern contrast against the darker siding while maintaining a natural stone appearance.
